content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_80020 A successful call to the IocReceiveGroup / IocReadGroup function indicates that data has been received successfully in the given parameters. The IocReceiveGroup / IocReadGroup function has to be generated in case of intra- core and inter-core communication.
